units.sourceHTML: 8.3 Generating the Merged Output Directly

units.text: With the ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧) option, ⟦2⟧ outputs the merged file directly. This is more efficient than using ⟦3⟧ to generate it, and works even with non-text files that ⟦4⟧ would reject. If you specify ⟦5⟧ without an ⟦6⟧ script option, ⟦7⟧ is assumed.
units.sourceHTML: With the --merge (-m) option, diff3 outputs the merged file directly. This is more efficient than using ed to generate it, and works even with non-text files that ed would reject. If you specify -m without an ed script option, -A is assumed.
